surveyed.source: Bridge frame along bearing 73 deg from the Gemeente Amsterdam register footprint BRU0242 (fixed spans 32 m x 9.9 m either side of the 4.75 m bascule section); deck kept 6 cm under the game's ride surface (scripts/landmarks/magere-brug-footprints.json rideProfile, bridge-deck-probe.ts), which over this unmeasured footprint is the relief, about 1 m under the real deck. Native X east, Z south, y = scene z; groundAltitudeMetres puts the pier feet (-2.3) on the runtime's anchor base (-0.252). Faces read from the boat panoramas TMX7316010203-000355_pano_0000_000633 and _000625 (CC BY 4.0) and Wikimedia Commons photographs; Rijksmonument 518383.
